high_level_description: This image is the cover of Vogue Hong Kong's May 2021 issue. The central figure is Kendall Jenner, a well-known model, posing in a striking and stylish manner. She is leaning forward with her hands resting on a white surface, which appears to be a table or a platform. Her long, dark hair flows down her back, adding a dramatic effect to the photograph. Kendall is wearing a form-fitting, white, long-sleeved top that accentuates her figure. She accessorizes with multiple black and gold bracelets on her right wrist, which adds a touch of elegance and sophistication to her look.
